text:
Maria: Quick sync — ACME pilot scope & resourcing. Need alignment on success criteria, prompt/eval set, infra access, and SE support. Can SE/eng owners confirm availability?
Alex: SE can cover ~8 hrs/wk during active test (weeks 1-4). Need dataset access + sample prompts by Monday.
James: Pricing ask from procurement: can we cap monthly spend at $6k for pilot? Need a back-of-envelope for token usage.
Alex: If we run ~100k tokens/day peak on hosted, rough cost ~ $4k-$7k/mo depending on model/quant. I'll calc numbers and share. Do we need Dedicated capacity or hosted?
Olivia: Security Qs: started the vendor questionnaire. Main asks: data retention, KMS/HSM, audit logs. Need SOC2 scope doc and contact from eng.
Priya: I'll pull our PII handling notes and examples. Do they expect on-prem for PHI? Customer mentioned some datasets may be PHI-adjacent.
James: Legal asked for KMS + tenant isolation notes. Procurement also wants a simple cost cap option.
Sam: From infra: private deployment lead time ~2 weeks (VPC peering, IP allowlist, firewall rules). Can fast-track if we get approvals.
Alex: Proposed success criteria: 1) Domain accuracy >=85% on our eval set, 2) Avg latency p95 <700ms, 3) Cost <= $6k/mo, 4) No regression on hallucination tests. Feedback?
Maria: Agree on criteria. Add: "end-to-end demo with customer scripts" as acceptance checklist item.
Priya: Prompt/eval plan: create 50 representative prompts + expected outputs. Two evaluation passes: smoke (week1) and deep (week3). Will own eval harness.
Alex: SE tasks: integrate sample prompts into harness, run smoke tests, instrument token metrics. Need 1x eng oncall during week1 rollout (4-6hrs).
Olivia: For the questionnaire I need a customer security contact and email. @Maria please share and cc me on intros.
Maria: Contact is tina@acme.com — will intro after we confirm timeline and kickoff slot.
James: Tentative timeline proposal: W1 kickoff & data transfer, W2 smoke eval + tuning, W3 tuning & interim report, W4 deep eval + final report.
Alex: Schedule is feasible if dataset arrives by Monday and we get KMS access. SE will reserve the 8 hrs/wk + one 4-hr onboarding block upfront.
Sam: Note — infra will request a temporary capacity bump for smoke tests (~+20% GPU). I'll include that in the runbook.
Priya: Deliverables list: prompt set (50), eval results (CSV + summary), runbook (access, endpoints, configs), final scorecard + recommendations.
Maria: Owners recap: Maria(AE) — customer comms & schedule; Alex(SE) — prompts & eval harness; Priya(Solutions) — eval design & scorecard; Sam(Infra) — environment & runbook; Olivia(Security) — questionnaire & security signoff; James(Sales) — pricing/procurement.
Alex: Current blockers: dataset transfer, KMS access, hosted vs private decision. Please flag if any of these can't be resolved by EOD.
James: I'll produce a short pricing estimate and a procurement one-pager by EOD tomorrow.
Maria: Quick poll — Friday 10am PT for a 30m kickoff with Acme + SE + Security? Reply with :+1: if that works.
Alex: :+1:
Priya: :+1:
Olivia: :+1:
Sam: :+1:
James: :+1:
Maria: Great — I'll schedule and send calendar invites + agenda. Thanks everyone!
